question: What permanent inbound QQBot gateway message limit should OpenClaw enforce while preserving every supported legitimate event?
rationale: The code can enforce any chosen value, but selecting 1 MiB versus a higher bounded limit trades memory-exhaustion resistance against an undocumented message-delivery compatibility boundary that repository evidence cannot resolve automatically.

options.title: Use a 16 MiB cap
options.body: Adopt the broader sibling-channel limit to retain substantial protection over the 100 MiB ws default while minimizing undocumented QQ event compatibility risk.

options.title: Approve the 1 MiB cap
options.body: Accept the tighter boundary and explicitly own the possibility that future or uncommon legitimate QQ events above 1 MiB will disconnect.

options.title: Wait for QQ size evidence
options.body: Pause until official guidance or representative production captures establish a defensible maximum and safety margin.
